svg.title: KFM Explorer walkthrough — from a place to a shareable, evidence-bounded result
svg.desc: Illustrative animated mock-up of the KFM Explorer cycling through eight steps: open the map, frame an area, switch on layers, move the time control, inspect a stream gauge, read the Evidence Drawer, create a report draft from the map, and copy a share link. Not a screenshot.

g.text: Every layer keeps its own source,
